records.title: 1951 as childhood
records.summary: Jack may speak of 1951 in the present tense. Punched-card rooms, festival futurity, and the smell of warm machines are closer to him than most of the twentieth century’s later paperwork.
records.jack_note: I am still learning the alphabet of holes.

records.title: Damaged exchange with Mabel
records.summary: Earliest surviving disturbance: a damaged exchange. MABEL: Jack, keep him talking. JACK: Until when? MABEL: Until he reaches us. Who “him” refers to is not established.
